WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS mine FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS s999 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, ROUND(m.mine,2) AS mine, ROUND(c.ctl,2) AS ctl, ROUND(m.mine-c.ctl,2) AS diff
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.business_date=d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, d.calendar_date

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, count(*) AS n, NULL AS amt FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*), NULL FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line_id', count(*), NULL FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', count(*), NULL FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_status_' || coalesce(o.status,'NO_ORDER') || '_' || CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' THEN 'TY' WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'other' END, count(*), sum(f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-20' AND DATE '2026-07-05' GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL SELECT 'webchannel_lines_not_store900', count(*), sum(net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND s.store_id<>900

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) AS c, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS ids, count(DISTINCT product_key) AS prods, count(DISTINCT net_amount) AS amts, count(DISTINCT quantity) AS qtys,
         min(sale_date) AS sale_date, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load, count(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) AS m, count(*) AS dup_groups, sum(c) AS rows_, sum(CASE WHEN prods=1 AND amts=1 AND qtys=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identical_groups, min(first_load) AS fl, max(last_load) AS ll, max(c) AS maxc, max(stores) AS maxstores
FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' THEN 'TY' ELSE 'LY' END AS yr,
       sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_sales,
       sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')) THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS undispatched_web_included
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY 1
